title: Cell pixel annotations

revision.description: Starts at 1; increase it when you save a changed annotation.

source.description: The video you annotated: its path, the SHA-256 of the file, and its decoded width and height.

frames.description: Every source frame, in order: frame_index starts at zero and timestamp_s is the frame's presentation time in the source, strictly increasing.

neurons.description: One entry per cell identity. The field name is historical; no claim is made about cell type. Each id is persistent across all frames, and each color is distinct and is used to render that cell.

neuron_id.description: The id of the cell in `neurons` (the field name is historical).

visibility.description: Describes the observation as a whole. not_visible and out_of_frame observations have empty masks. The uncertain mask describes specific ambiguous pixels even when other parts are visible.

body.description: Every pixel you can attribute to this cell in this frame, soma and any attached processes together. There is no body/branch distinction in this task.

branches.description: Always [] in this task. The field stays because the shared schema and renderer require it.

uncertain.description: Optional candidate pixels whose ownership you cannot resolve. They are excluded from body and must be reported as unresolved in your final response.

observations.description: One observation per cell per included frame, including frames where the cell is absent. Masks of different cells are independent, so ambiguous ownership can stay uncertain instead of being forced onto one cell.

mask.description: Lossless horizontal runs [y, x_start, x_end] with an exclusive x_end: [10, 20, 23] is exactly pixels (20, 10), (21, 10) and (22, 10). Runs have integer bounds, are sorted by row and then starting column, must not overlap within a mask, and touching runs are coalesced. An empty mask is [].

description: Pixel annotations of dark cells in a microscopy clip, saved as annotations.json. All pixel coordinates refer to the decoded source image: integer (x, y) is column x, row y, with (0, 0) at the top left. Frame indices start at zero. Keep one observation per cell per included frame, including explicit absence states. Render with `uv run neuron-render`. This schema checks structure only; separately validate run bounds (0 <= y < height, 0 <= x_start < x_end <= width), that the masks of one observation do not overlap, unique cell/frame observations, complete frame coverage, and the references between frames, cell ids and observations. A schema-valid file can still contain wrong masks.
